author: Contributor 45
about: Replay of LinkedIn's published examples (spec/doc-examples.json) for the operations the twin serves: the Posts page's creates (text, video, article, reshare, targeted, mention, hashtag) and reads, its finder and delete, and its error table; the Images page's initializeUpload, upload, read and its forbidden answer; the Videos page's five initializeUpload variants, part, captions and thumbnail uploads, finalize, read, forbidden answer and size limit; Organization Access Control's four finders; Organization Lookup's read and its 403; Sign In with LinkedIn's userinfo; and the versioning page's two version errors. Every organization, image and video URN the pages publish stands for the World's own, made by the setup: an administrator, the page, the application and its token, a member with no role, and the media the posts carry.

notReplayed.createPost#doc Organic Targeted Post Cre: a targeted post’s audience must be greater than 300 members of the page’s followers, as the page says, and the World’s pages are followed by no one: the twin refuses it (422), as LinkedIn refuses an audience too small
notReplayed.initializeImageUpload#doc Image with Med: the library is an ad account’s (urn:li:sponsoredAccount:123456789), which this World does not hold: Campaign Manager’s ad accounts are not twinned, so the twin refuses the entry as LinkedIn refuses an entity the viewer has no permission on
notReplayed.initializeVideoUpload#doc Video with Med: as the image library example: the ad account is not in this World
notReplayed.getPost#doc Get Posts by URN: a Direct Sponsored Content post (adContext.isDsc, dscAdAccount) is made by an ad account in Campaign Manager, which this World does not hold; the reads of organic posts are replayed above
notReplayed.createPost#doc 409 CONFLICT: a write conflict is LinkedIn’s own concurrent write meeting the caller’s; no World draws one
notReplayed.createPost#doc 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: an unexpected server-side error is LinkedIn failing; no World draws one
notReplayed.createPost#doc 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: the service being unavailable is LinkedIn’s outage; no World draws one
